scenarios.name: Filter out a selected recent part

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent parts and assemblies are displayed in List View
one part row is checked and no other rows are checked
the user opens Filter and selects Assembly
assembly rows are displayed and the selected part is not displayed
Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed
the user clears the active filter
the part row is displayed again without a checkmark
Open Selected and Remove Selected remain absent
